name: smart-sb-public-portal
description: SMART-SB public portal - static export for Cloudflare Pages

scripts.dev: node scripts/build-data.mjs && node scripts/build-search-index.mjs public/pagefind && next dev -H 0.0.0.0
scripts.build: node scripts/build-data.mjs && next build && node scripts/build-search-index.mjs out/pagefind
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx wrangler deploy
